summary.text: Marilyn Dondero Loop is a Democratic state senator from Nevada who has represented District 8 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she worked in textbook publishing and as an elementary school teacher before and alongside her legislative service.

paragraphs.text: Loop earned bachelor's and master's degrees in education, curriculum and instruction from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
Her professional experience includes working in textbook publishing and as an elementary school teacher.
Loop served in Nevada State Assembly District 5 from 2008 to 2014 and assumed her Senate seat on November 7, 2018.
In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Finance Committee and vice chair of the Senate Education Committee.
